title: Рецензия и авария  (The Review and the Accident)

scenes.title: Accident Outside the Hotel
scenes.summary: Denis hurts his arm in a minor traffic accident outside the hotel while Barinov and Sasha argue about tomorrow's football match and Sasha's wedding.

scenes.title: An Article About a Rival
scenes.summary: Barinov tries to place a football bet on credit before Mikhail reads him a glowing magazine review praising rival restaurateur Andrey Dyagilev.

scenes.title: Invitation to Lunch
scenes.summary: Barinov invites Elena to lunch, Lyova gets permission to dine with his mother, and Eleonora angrily rejects breakfast in her room.

scenes.title: Ice for Denis
scenes.summary: Katya brings ice for Denis's hurt arm at the bar and offers to drive him to the clinic for an X-ray while Sveta fumes about the accident.

scenes.title: Meeting Larisa
scenes.summary: Lyova meets his mother's friend Larisa in the dining room and realizes Larisa is a young nurse from the local clinic.

scenes.title: In Line for the Doctor
scenes.summary: Lyova's mother leaves him alone with Larisa at the table while Denis tries to apologize to Katya outside the X-ray room.

scenes.title: A Strange Lunch
scenes.summary: Gulya catches Lyova having lunch alone with Larisa after his mother slips away, and Barinov unveils a wedding menu tasting for Elena.

scenes.title: Eleonora's Wrath
scenes.summary: Denis tells Kostya that things are improving with Katya, but Eleonora storms into the restaurant and fires both Denis and Sveta.

scenes.title: Argument About Reputation
scenes.summary: Barinov asks Elena to write a review of his restaurant, and they argue when she refuses in order to protect her reputation as an unbiased critic.

scenes.title: The Dashcam Recording
scenes.summary: Katya promises to speak with Eleonora about the firings, Lyova tries to reassure Gulya, and Sveta tells Denis she has dashcam footage of the crash.

scenes.title: The Open Profile Page
scenes.summary: Denis asks Sveta out for coffee to cheer her up, while Senya and Fedya show Barinov that Elena left her social media page open on the office laptop.

scenes.title: Accidental Publication
scenes.summary: Barinov, Mikhail, and the chefs jokingly draft an over-the-top review of Restaurant Victor on Elena's account, and Fedya accidentally publishes it.

scenes.title: Suspicions and Tears
scenes.summary: Ainura suspects Larisa wants to marry Lyova for his apartment, while Katya comforts a heartbroken Eleonora in her hotel bathroom.

scenes.title: Mother's Advice and a Dance
scenes.summary: Eleonora advises Katya on love and agrees to rehire Denis and Sveta, while Denis and Sveta share a dance at the coffee shop.

scenes.title: The Sore Arm and the Scandal
scenes.summary: Denis's sore arm cuts short his dance with Sveta at the cafe, and Elena confronts Barinov over the fake review posted on her page.

scenes.title: Elena's Offense
scenes.summary: Elena scolds Barinov for disrespecting her work and walks out, while Lyova brings Gulya home only to find Larisa having dinner with his mother.

scenes.title: Battle for the Apartment
scenes.summary: Lyova tells his mother he has chosen Gulya, and in the kitchen Larisa drops her friendly mask and tells Gulya that the apartment belongs to her.

scenes.title: Lyova's Choice
scenes.summary: Larisa complains to Lyova's mother after Gulya pours soup on her, and when his mother demands he choose between them, Lyova leaves with Gulya.

scenes.title: Reconciliation and Good News
scenes.summary: Barinov reconciles with Elena over the phone, and Katya tells Denis that she convinced her mother not to fire him and Sveta.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Kiss
scenes.summary: To keep proud Sveta from quitting, Denis lies that Barinov got their jobs back instead of Katya, and Sveta kisses him just as Katya walks in.
